Topics · Is there a God?

Can faith be 'I don't know yet'?

Angels say 'we have no knowledge', unashamed. Above each knower is another. A prayer asks for more knowledge.

Part 1 of 3

﴿قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ لَا عِلْمَ لَنَآ إِلَّا مَا عَلَّمْتَنَآ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَلِيمُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ﴾

Translation of the meaning

They said, "Exalted are You; we have no knowledge except what You have taught us. Indeed, it is You who is the Knowing,[19] the Wise."[20]

Translator's notes

[19] Whose eternal and absolute knowledge encompasses the truth and essence of all things, seen or unseen, present or absent, neither preceded by ignorance nor followed by forgetfulness. [20] Whose wisdom includes precise and perfect knowledge of all realities and outcomes, according to which He decrees and causes various circumstances and occurrences.

Quran · Al-Baqarah 2:32

Translation

Not to us, Yahweh, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake.

Original · Hebrew

לֹ֤א לָ֥נוּ יְהוָ֗ה לֹ֫א לָ֥נוּ כִּֽי־לְ֭שִׁמְךָ תֵּ֣ן כָּב֑וֹד עַל־חַ֝סְדְּךָ֗ עַל־אֲמִתֶּֽךָ׃

the Psalms · 115:1

World English Bible

Start with the lab. Your best sentence is 'I don't know yet', and a good scientist says it without shame. The Quran contains that sentence, said by the angels. In the passage, they are asked to name what they were not taught, and answer: glory to You, we have no knowledge except what You taught us. Nobody in the story treats this as failure. It is the right answer.

A question for you

What does 'I don't know yet' feel like in your field?

If you sayRespectable.
ThenIt is so in this story. No one thinks less of the angels for saying it.
If you sayRisky.
ThenMany feel that. The verse shows that candour here leads to learning, not to loss.
If you sayWhere the interesting work starts.
ThenThat is close to the story: after the admission comes the teaching.

Part 2 of 3

﴿فَبَدَأَ بِأَوْعِيَتِهِمْ قَبْلَ وِعَآءِ أَخِيهِ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَخْرَجَهَا مِن وِعَآءِ أَخِيهِ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ كِدْنَا لِيُوسُفَ ۖ مَا كَانَ لِيَأْخُذَ أَخَاهُ فِى دِينِ ٱلْمَلِكِ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ نَرْفَعُ دَرَجَـٰتٍ مَّن نَّشَآءُ ۗ وَفَوْقَ كُلِّ ذِى عِلْمٍ عَلِيمٌ﴾

Translation of the meaning

So he began [the search] with their bags before the bag of his brother; then he extracted it from the bag of his brother. Thus did We plan for Joseph. He could not have taken his brother within the religion [i.e., law] of the king except that Allāh willed. We raise in degrees whom We will, but over every possessor of knowledge is one [more] knowing.[609]

Translator's notes

[609] Ending with the ultimate knowledge of Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā).

Quran · Yusuf 12:76

Translation

He commanded the steward of his house, saying, “Fill the men’s sacks with food, as much as they can carry, and put each man’s money in his sack’s mouth. Put my cup, the silver cup, in the sack’s mouth of the youngest, with his grain money.” He did according to the word that Joseph had spoken.

Original · Hebrew

וַיְצַ֞ו אֶת־אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־בֵּיתוֹ֮ לֵאמֹר֒ מַלֵּ֞א אֶת־אַמְתְּחֹ֤ת הָֽאֲנָשִׁים֙ אֹ֔כֶל כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר יוּכְל֖וּן שְׂאֵ֑ת וְשִׂ֥ים כֶּֽסֶף־אִ֖ישׁ בְּפִ֥י אַמְתַּחְתּֽוֹ׃ וְאֶת־גְּבִיעִ֞י גְּבִ֣יעַ הַכֶּ֗סֶף תָּשִׂים֙ בְּפִי֙ אַמְתַּ֣חַת הַקָּטֹ֔ן וְאֵ֖ת כֶּ֣סֶף שִׁבְר֑וֹ וַיַּ֕עַשׂ כִּדְבַ֥ר יוֹסֵ֖ף אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֵּֽר׃

the Torah (Genesis) · 44:1-2

World English Bible

Every scientist knows what it is to reach the edge of a field and meet someone who knows more. The Quran says it as a rule: above every possessor of knowledge there is one who knows more. So knowledge comes in layers, none of us is at the top, and no one needs to pretend to be. The chain does not end with the loudest voice. Many read its last link as God.

A question for you

Where do you feel 'above every knower' in your work?

If you sayIn a teacher I learn from.
ThenLearning from one who knows more is an honour in every field, and what the verse describes.
If you sayIn questions I cannot solve.
ThenThose questions grow with you, and the verse makes them natural.
If you sayI do not feel it.
ThenThen it is a sentence waiting for you at the edge of your field.

Part 3 of 3

﴿فَتَعَـٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۗ وَلَا تَعْجَلْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يُقْضَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ وَحْيُهُۥ ۖ وَقُل رَّبِّ زِدْنِى عِلْمًا﴾

Translation of the meaning

So high [above all] is Allāh, the Sovereign,[861] the Truth.[862] And, [O Muḥammad], do not hasten with [recitation of] the Qur’ān before its revelation is completed to you, and say, "My Lord, increase me in knowledge."

Translator's notes

[861] And owner of everything in existence. [862] Or "the True Reality," i.e., the real and permanent existence upon which all other existence depends.

Quran · Ta-Ha 20:114

Translation

if you seek her as silver, and search for her as for hidden treasures; then you will understand the fear of Yahweh, and find the knowledge of God. For Yahweh gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.

Original · Hebrew

אִם־תְּבַקְשֶׁ֥נָּה כַכָּ֑סֶף וְֽכַמַּטְמוֹנִ֥ים תַּחְפְּשֶֽׂנָּה׃ אָ֗ז תָּ֭בִין יִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְדַ֖עַת אֱלֹהִ֣ים תִּמְצָֽא׃ כִּֽי־יְ֭הוָה יִתֵּ֣ן חָכְמָ֑ה מִ֝פִּ֗יו דַּ֣עַת וּתְבוּנָֽה׃

Proverbs · 2:4-6

World English Bible

Here is a prayer that fits a lab. The Prophet is told, in the middle of receiving revelation, not to hurry ahead of it before it is complete, and to say: my Lord, increase me in knowledge. Patience and a request for more knowledge, in the same breath. Faith, in this verse, does not mean knowing everything. It is a stance of asking for more, and waiting for it.

A question for you

What does faith look like in someone who says 'I don't know yet'?

If you sayTrust that an answer exists.
ThenEvery scientist knows that trust, and the verse turns it into a prayer.
If you sayTrust in a source I have not yet met.
ThenThat is the meaning the verse adds: the One you ask is also the one you trust.
If you sayPatience.
ThenPatience is the first thing the verse says, before the prayer.

The same in the other books
